This role joins an established business with a lot of data and strong foundations. Questioning how we do things today and improving them together with the teams is encouraged. jobs.description: About Tacto Tacto builds Industrial AI for procurement in manufacturing. Built for industrial complexity, designed to optimize every procurement decision. Manufacturing is the backbone of the European economy, and supply chains are its biggest challenge. Yet procurement in many companies still runs on Excel and legacy systems. With AI, we are fundamentally changing how manufacturers buy: measurably lower material costs and far less manual work. Your role You open Poland for Tacto and win the first customers that everything else builds on. Why this role exists Tacto is the category leader for procurement in DACH manufacturing. We have strong product-market fit and a proven playbook, and now we are taking it into the rest of Europe. Poland is one of our expansion markets. It has become one of Europe’s major manufacturing hubs, and the category is still wide open there. That’s where you come in: you take the market and build it from the ground up. You research the market, find what resonates and win the first customers and reference logos. What you learn becomes the blueprint for how Tacto grows in Poland from there. Why your role matters A real greenfield. You have the freedom to shape how Tacto wins in your market, from the ICP to the first reference logos. You’re not starting alone. A stellar expansion team is your sparring partner, and proven sales assets and a tested approach from DACH are your foundation. You write the blueprint. jobs.description: Bewerbungen nehmen wir ausschließlich über unsere Website entgegen. Dort sind es zehn Fragen, deine Kontaktdaten und der Arbeitsvertrag – alles in einem Ablauf, ohne Lebenslauf und ohne Anschreiben. Fragen zur Stelle beantworten wir dagegen gern per E-Mail an ----- uns Probantica ist ein Anbieter für Qualitätstests aus Köln. Wir prüfen im Auftrag von Unternehmen, ob digitale Produkte und Abläufe vor Ort im Alltag funktionieren. Die Tests machen bei uns angestellte Qualitätsmanager:innen – Menschen mit Vertrag, feste Ansprechperson und klaren Vorgaben. Worum es geht Unternehmen müssen wissen, ob ihre Apps, Websites und Filialen im Alltag wirklich funktionieren. Als Kunde gehst du die angebotenen Abläufe durch: App öffnen, Konto anlegen, Formular ausfüllen, Bestellung abschließen, in eine Filiale gehen. Du testest den Prozess von Anfang bis Ende, dokumentierst jeden Schritt mit Uhrzeit und Screenshot und markierst die Stellen, an denen etwas hakt oder unklar bleibt. Vor jedem Auftrag bekommst du eine Anleitung mit Schritten, Zeitrahmen und den Fragen, die am Ende beantwortet sein müssen. Kein Rätselraten, kein Vertrieb, keine Kaltakquise. Getestet wird auf deinem eigenen Gerät, in deiner Nähe. Deine Aufgaben Digitale Produkte testen: App, Website oder Online-Prozess einmal vollständig durchlaufen – von der Anmeldung bis zum Abschluss. Als Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d) in unserem teilautomatisierten Fulfillment Center (FC) in Falkensee bist du der Motor des Standorts. Unterstützt von Investoren wie der Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation bauen wir gemeinsam das modernste, 100 % elektrische Liefersystem Europas. Sei von Anfang an dabei: Im August 2027 eröffnen wir unser neues teilautomatisiertes FC in Falkensee. Du kannst aber schon früher bei uns starten und dein Onboarding an einem unserer bestehenden Standorte absolvieren - zum Beispiel in unserem manuellen FC in Ludwigsfelde oder unserem vollautomatisierten FC in Oberhausen. So bekommst du einen umfassenden Einblick in unsere Operations und bist bestens vorbereitet, wenn wir in Falkensee an den Start gehen. Das erwartet dich  Teamleitung: Du bist Coach und Vorbild – mit deinem echten, intrinsischen Interesse an Menschen führst und inspirierst du dein Team aus 5 Lead Shoppers und über 150 Shoppers. Schichtleitung: Im FC behältst du stets den Überblick, priorisierst Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass jede Bestellung pünktlich rausgeht. Abwechslung: Du erlebst den perfekten Mix aus Action direkt auf der Lagerfläche (4 Tage pro Woche) und strategischem Deep Dive im FC Office (1 Tag pro Woche). Prozessoptimierung: Stillstand gibt es bei uns nicht. Du hast Ideen? Hier entwickelst du eigene Logistikprojekte und hebst unsere Abläufe durch deinen Tatendrang aufs nächste Level. Ownership: Du hast Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, auch wenn Dinge mal außerhalb deines unmittelbaren Bereichs liegen. Du schaust über den Tellerrand hinaus und nimmst die Dinge proaktiv selbst in die Hand. jobs.title: Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Kurz und knapp Du hast dein Studium erfolgreich abgeschlossen und suchst nach einer spannenden Führungsrolle als Karrierestart in einem zukunftsorientierten Umfeld? Bei Picnic bieten wir dir in unserem Fulfillment Center (FC) in Hamburg die Möglichkeit, als Operations Supervisor (m/w/d) durchzustarten! Wir sind der innovative Online-Supermarkt, der mit über 3.000 EPVs (Electric Picnic Vehicle) täglich Lebensmittel in über 100 deutschen Städten ausliefert. Unser erfolgreiches Konzept wird durch Investoren wie die Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation gestützt. Werde Teil unseres dynamischen Teams und bringe deine analytischen und organisatorischen Stärken ein, um die Lager-Performance zu steigern und das Einkaufserlebnis unserer KundInnen zu verbessern. Das erwartet dich  Teamführung: Du bist der zentrale Anker und die erste Ansprechperson für dein Team - leite, motiviere, fördere und inspiriere täglich ein Team aus Teamleitenden und über 100 Lagermitarbeitenden. Schichtleitung: Du steuerst den täglichen Betrieb im FC und sorgst während deiner Schicht mit Struktur und Sorgfalt dafür, dass alle operativen Aktivitäten priorisiert und zuverlässig abgeschlossen werden. Prozessoptimierung: Übernimm die Verantwortung für eigene, standortbasierte Optimierungsprojekte - du bringst pragmatische Lösungen ein und verbesserst gemeinsam mit dem Team stetig unsere logistischen Abläufe. Vielseitigkeit:  Meistere den spannenden Balanceakt zwischen operativer Führungsaufgabe (3-4 Schichtleitungstage) und strategischer Arbeit (1-2 Officetage) - für eine abwechslungsreiche und erfüllende Tätigkeit. Das bringst du mit Du hast ein Studium (Bachelor/Master) in Logistikmanagement, Supply Chain Management, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich erfolgreich abgeschlossen. Du bist affin für Logistikthemen und hast idealerweise erste praktische Erfahrung im Lagerumfeld sammeln können (z.B. in Form von Praktika, Werkstudium oder Ähnlichem). Du sprichst fließend Deut

jobs.description: Mission De nouveaux modèles, ouverts ou fermés, sortent chaque mois : encore faut-il choisir ceux qui sont assez bons pour la production, et le démontrer. Applications et agents s’appuient sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM), et la partie modèle de ces systèmes est entre vos mains. Nos clients s’en servent pour répondre à leurs propres clients, traiter des documents et interroger leurs connaissances. Le modèle retenu doit tenir l’objectif de coût et de qualité. Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez savoir si un système d’IA donne des réponses justes, et pas seulement s’il tourne. Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype AI Engineer.   Activités et responsabilités Les Product Engineers construisent l’application autour du modèle ; le comportement du modèle à l’intérieur vous revient. Les Context & Analytics Engineers préparent les connaissances que vos agents retrouvent, et les Platform Engineers exploitent le serving, le harness et l’observabilité sur lesquels vous vous appuyez. Avec l’AI Product Manager et les experts métier du client, une bonne réponse se définit, puis les résultats s’examinent ensemble. La relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues font partie du quotidien. jobs.description: 🤖 Who we are We’re building Mo — a health companion for everyone. We’re a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise . We are building Mo, an intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care. Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise - through chat, voice, or video. That’s what we are building 🤖. We kicked off the project in 2023, and we have launched Mo to all our french members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe. 🚀 What keeps us up at night We’re building a medical agent that works — reliably, safely, and at scale . You’ll work at the intersection of product engineering, ML engineering, and medical expertise . Our mission is to build the most accurate and reliable medical agent in the world , while delivering an outstanding conversational experience . Things we’re working on: 💬 Deliver the most memorable chatting experience — You’ll work on making Mo the obvious choice when it comes to asking a health question. It means having a world-class snappy and delightful chatting experience, blazing fast time to answer, and rich content shared. 🧱 Integrate Mo with Alan services and our healthcare system — You’ll work on integrating Mo with our other services (digital chat with HP, map of physical location of HPs, tailored prevention programs, …) to help members get from words to actions. ➕ Extend our architecture to support the next chapters of Mo — You’ll work on our architecture, and agentic framework, to support Mo’s next needs (get more context, use new skills, be accessible in other countries we operate in) If you’re excited by the idea of building the future of healthcare, this is the team for you - we're at the start of the journey. Notre force est de déployer une IA à impact, à grande échelle. Notre mission : mobiliser cette puissance pour répondre aux défis les plus urgents de notre temps. Nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un impact constant à grande échelle, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN. Contexte Les modèles marketing sont mis à jour à mesure que de nouvelles données arrivent : ventes hebdomadaires, résultats de campagnes, comportement des clients. Ils comprennent les marketing mix models (MMM), qui estiment le retour sur investissement de chaque canal média, ainsi que les modèles de demande et de promotion et les modèles de réponse client. Chaque mise à jour fait bouger les estimations, et la première question des métiers est : pourquoi ont-elles bougé ? Notre équipe a développé une méthode qui y répond de façon exacte pour les modèles bayésiens. Elle répartit le déplacement de toute quantité a posteriori entre des groupes d'observations : semaines, campagnes, régions, segments de clients ou expériences. La méthode est en cours d'évaluation par les pairs. Un premier prototype sur le MMM suit déjà une estimation semaine après semaine et lève une alerte quand une mise à jour la déplace plus que prévu. Sujet : pourquoi l'estimation a-t-elle bougé ? Attribution bayésienne en ligne pour les modèles marketing. Volet

jobs.title: Intern AI Researcher: Anomaly Detection for Predictive Maintenance in Distributed Storage
jobs.description: About Scality Scality builds data infrastructure software for enterprise AI, cyber resilience, and sovereign control at multi-petabyte to exabyte scale. Its AI Data Infrastructure platform reduces operational burden through AI-powered autonomous operations while aligning the right storage media, performance, and protection to each workload through human-approved lifecycle policies. Built on CORE5 cyber resilience and open-code principles, Scality software delivers extreme performance, operational simplicity, and sustainable economics. The world's most demanding enterprises and government organizations depend on Scality to power AI initiatives, defend critical data, and build infrastructure that lasts for decades. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality is where AI remembers, learns, and thinks. F Follow us on LinkedIn. Visit www.scality.com and our blog. Context & Motivation A distributed storage cluster continuously emits telemetry at every level, from the platform and S3 service down to each server and disk. A failing disk, server or storage node leaves traces in these multivariate time series, from subtle shifts in a few metrics to system-wide disruption. Detecting and diagnosing these anomalies early is critical for: Predictive maintenance: isolating or replacing a component before it impacts service Faster diagnosis: pointing support engineers to the root cause, not just to an alert Higher availability and durability of customer data This internship is part of a joint research project between Scality and an INRIA research team. The project released SHAD (Scality High-dimensional Anomaly Detection), an open benchmark published at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations & Datasets Track). It contains 215 real 171-dimensional time series from Scality RING clusters, annotated for injected disk, server and storage-node failures. SHAD's baselines show the problem is far from solved. jobs.description: At Vio , we believe booking accommodation should feel fair and effortless, never overwhelming or unclear. As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites so that they can find the best place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. Our goal is to help travelers book like an insider. That means cutting through the noise and complexity of hotel booking and surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays, booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology that travelers can trust. jobs.description: Before a company publishes its annual report, finance teams have to turn financial data into a complete set of statements and disclosures. Balances need to be mapped, figures carried forward and updated, and supporting information brought together into a draft. Auditors then check that the notes match the primary statements, this year reconciles with last year, and every total adds up. Preparing and reviewing those statements takes days of detailed work, and errors can carry through into a published report. Today, audit teams rely on Financial Statement Suite (FSS) to read statements, run checks, and show reviewers what it found and where, so they can make the call and stand behind it. jobs.title: Platform Engineer - Data Resilience and Recovery platform
jobs.description: Build and own a self-service, multi-tenant platform that keeps the critical data of 20+ customers recoverable Do you like building platforms that other teams consume, at scale, across private and public clouds, with security and tenant isolation as non-negotiables? At Schuberg Philis, the world is shifting from traditional backup to data security and resilience. We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to strengthen our Data Management-as-a-Service (DMS) team and help us build the next generation of our platform. About the Team The DMS team builds and runs a shared, fully segregated data resilience platform that serves more than 20 of our customers. Customer teams consume it through self-service, and they handle their own day-to-day backup and restore operations. That means you won’t spend your days on job monitoring, restore tickets or backup schedules. Your customers are internal and external engineering teams, and your product is the platform they build on. You’ll join a dedicated group of data security experts within our larger Services Team and work closely with our sbp.cloud team, who operate our self-built sovereign cloud solutions. With our plan-build-run approach, you take end-to-end ownership: you design it, you build it, you run it. The Challenge Running one platform for 20+ customers means solving the hard problems of platform engineering: Multi-tenancy by design: strict isolation of data, access, and performance between customers, on shared infrastructure. Self-service at scale: APIs, guardrails and automation that let customer teams onboard and operate independently, without tickets. jobs.title: Senior Mechatronic System Architect | Medical Robotics (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Senior Mechatronic System Architect | Medical Robotics (m/f/d) Location: Maastricht, Aachen, and Eindhoven region, working mainly on-site with our development partner in Maastricht. Regular travel to Hamburg and to clinical sites, about 2 to 4 days per month. Reports to: CTO About the venture: ROB E ROB E is a Hamburg-based medtech startup and part of the NLC Health Ventures portfolio. We are developing a robotic system that holds and steers a standard transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) probe during structural heart interventions. Interventionalists get stable, reproducible echo views, and echocardiographers no longer have to stand next to the patient in the X-ray field. Our first-generation prototype has been used in a first-in-human study with published results. We are now developing the next generation from scratch as a fully compliant medical device for CE marking and FDA clearance. The team includes a CTO, a System Software Architect and a Head of Quality & Regulatory. The role You are the mechatronic design authority of ROB E. You own the system architecture, the hardware requirements and the technical decisions for the mechanics, drives, sensing and electronics of our robot. You work on site with our engineering development partner in the Maastricht area and steer their team on our behalf. This is a hands-on senior role: you design yourself, review the work of others and make sure the hardware is safe, verifiable and ready for design transfer. jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy. jobs.title: (Senior) Consultant* - Murex/Capital Markets (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Location: Frankfurt, Berlin, München oder Düsseldorf (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Capital Markets | Type: Permanent Gestalte die Zukunft moderner Kapitalmarktplattformen mit Murex MX.3 Die Rolle Du möchtest komplexe Kapitalmarktprozesse technologisch weiterentwickeln und dabei an der Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereich und IT arbeiten? Dann werde Teil unseres Capital Markets Teams und begleite führende Finanzinstitute bei der Weiterentwicklung ihrer Murex-Landschaften. Wir suchen insbesondere Persönlichkeiten mit einem technisch-funktionalen Hintergrund, die Business Analyse, Lösungsdesign und Systemumsetzung miteinander verbinden. Deine Aufgaben Du begleitest anspruchsvolle Transformations- und Implementierungsprojekte rund um die Murex MX.3 Plattform bei führenden Banken und Finanzdienstleistern. Du analysierst fachliche und technische Anforderungen, entwickelst Lösungsdesigns und unterstützt die Konfiguration, Integration sowie das Testing neuer Funktionen. Du arbeitest eng mit Front Office, Risk, Operations, Finance und IT-Teams zusammen und fungierst als Bindeglied zwischen Fachbereich und Technologie. Du unterstützt die Optimierung und Digitalisierung von Kapitalmarktprozessen entlang des gesamten Trade Lifecycles. Du übernimmst schrittweise Verantwortung für Arbeitspakete, Teilprojekte und die fachliche Steuerung kleinerer Projektteams. Dein Profil Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium sowie relevante Berufserfahrung in Beratungs-, IT- oder Transformationsprojekten im Financial-Services-Umfeld. Sehr gute Kenntnisse von Kapitalmarktprodukten und -prozessen, beispielsweise in den Bereichen Fixed Income, Derivate, FX/MM, Risk, Operations oder Accounting. Praktische Erfahrung mit Murex MX.3 als Business Analyst, Engineer, Key User, Application Owner oder Berater. Ausgeprägtes Interesse an technischen Fragestellungen wie Systemintegration, Datenflüssen, Schnittstellen, Migrationen, Konfiguration oder Testing. Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie star

jobs.title: Senior Sofware Engineer, Operational Excellence
jobs.description: Change the way the world travels Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours. Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step. Team mission Incidents interrupt operations, drain team productivity, and erode user trust. As a member of the Operational Excellence team, you will help GetYourGuide notice problems sooner, fix them faster, and stop the same ones from coming back, so our travelers and suppliers see fewer disruptions and trust us more. As we push boldly into AI-powered experiences, we don’t ignore the risks that increased output velocity creates. Faster change means more places for silent failures to hide. You will help our engineering organisation move fast with confidence, with the safeguards (tests, safe rollouts, monitoring, clear ownership) that catch problems before customers do. Observability and cost efficiency are part of the same job: teams can’t fix or own what they can’t see. You will build the tooling, standards, and habits that make operational excellence a shared standard across all engineering teams, from blameless learning after every incident to alerts teams trust and cost visibility per team. Your mission You will act as an "engineer for the engineers" — partnering with other engineering teams to raise the bar on reliability, speed, and confidence in their systems. Incident management & reliability Drive down how often incidents happen, how long it takes us to notice them, and how long it takes to fix them, with a focus on catching problems with monitors instead of by chance Lead post-incident reviews, translate learnings into systemic improvement

jobs.description: Location and travel You can be based in Europe; across several countries that we hire in. We expect significant travel across the Europe, with occasional travel to other regions when the audience quality justifies it. The exact cadence will change with the event calendar, but you should expect travel to be a meaningful part of the job. Why this role? Langfuse has grown mostly through product-led, open-source adoption. We built a strong product, wrote useful docs and examples, stayed close to users, shipped in public, and helped developers understand how to build better AI applications. However, many of the highest-signal moments happen in person: hallway conversations, workshops, meetups, dinners, conference demos, and technical talks. We want someone who can own that motion end to end; put Langfuse in the right AI engineering rooms, make the product clear to technical audiences, and turn in-person conversations into durable marketing momentum. The goal is not to do every event. The goal is to make the right events excellent, scalable, and measurable. What you'll do Represent Langfuse at conferences, meetups, workshops, customer events, partner events, and community gatherings across Europe Run live demos and technical sessions on tracing, evals, prompt management, datasets, metrics, and related LLM engineering workflows. Partner with ClickHouse field marketing, sales, solutions, product marketing, and engineering teams where it helps Langfuse show up well. Turn event learnings into useful artifacts: better messaging, better demos, better docs, better talks, better customer stories, and sharper product feedback. jobs.title: Langfuse - Senior Product Engineer, Integrations
jobs.description: Why Integrations Engineering at Langfuse Your work puts Langfuse into developers’ hands. Our SDKs are downloaded 26M+ times per month, and for many developers the first thing they touch is an integration — a few lines of code that connect their favorite framework to Langfuse. When that experience is seamless, they’re wow’ed. When it’s not, we might have lost them. You’ll own that critical first impression across 40+ framework integrations. You’ll live at the frontier of LLM application development. The AI framework ecosystem moves fast — new agent frameworks, orchestration libraries, and model providers emerge every week. You’ll be among the first to instrument them, giving you unmatched exposure to how cutting-edge AI applications are built. The developers you serve are some of the most ambitious software engineers in the world, and working closely with them will make you an expert on LLM engineering yourself. Everything you build is open source and immediately visible. All Langfuse integrations are MIT-licensed. When you ship a new integration or improve an existing one, thousands of developers benefit the same day — and they’ll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on Twitter, and in our community channels. What You’ll Do Build and maintain framework integrations. Langfuse integrates with 40+ frameworks and model providers: OpenAI SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pydantic AI, OpenAI Agents, CrewAI, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, LiveKit, and many more. You’ll own these integrations end-to-end — from initial implementation to ongoing maintenance as frameworks evolve. When a new framework gains traction, you’ll be among the first to instrument it. Design new integration patterns for emerging frameworks. When a framework or a new agent orchestrator appears, you’ll evaluate it, design the right instrumentation approach (callback handler, decorator, OTEL auto-instrumentation, or a combination), build the integration, write the docs, and ship it. jobs.title: Langfuse - Product Designer
jobs.description: Why Design at Langfuse Your work will shape how engineers build with AI. Langfuse is often the primary interface engineers use to debug, evaluate, and improve their LLM applications. The designs you ship will be used for hours each day by thousands of developers and non-developers. They'll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on X, and in our community Slack channels. Everything we build is open source (MIT-licensed) and immediately visible. The design challenges here are genuinely hard. You're designing for technical users and business users alike who care about information density, speed, and precision. Traces contain dozens of nested LLM calls with massive prompts and completions. Users need to set up evaluators, manage prompt versions, configure integrations, and build monitoring dashboards before they even start analyzing results. You need to make both the setup and the daily use feel intuitive and easy. You will also have direct exposure to how cutting-edge LLM applications are built. Deeply understanding the problems our users solve will make you a better designer and along the way makes you an expert on LLM engineering yourself. You will grow at Langfuse by Owning our product design end-to-end. You'll be the first dedicated designer at Langfuse. Today, our engineers design as they build, which has gotten us far, but we need someone who can elevate the entire experience. You'll own the design system, and visual language across the product. You'll set the standard for how Langfuse looks and feels. Making data-dense interfaces intuitive. Langfuse surfaces traces, scores, costs, latencies, token counts, prompt versions, and evaluation results. You'll figure out how to present complex, nested data in ways that help engineers find what they need fast. Simplifying complex workflows. jobs.description: Our Mission Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model . Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg. Team Culture At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We believe a strong engineering culture is the key to model training success. We like Extreme Programming and favor trunk-based development. We often mob-program, which keeps us aligned and means we always learn from each other. About the Role As an AI R&D Engineer in Model Training (f/m/d), you will join our model training team in Heidelberg or Berlin. Most of the team is based in Heidelberg. The model training team is building and improving our model training pipeline, which has been used to train Kolibri. You will work across our full stack. Some weeks you might be optimizing how training loads are scheduled on our cluster and making the pipeline more robust and performant so we can iterate faster. Other weeks, you will be enabling large-scale code execution for reinforcement learning. And at other times, you might dig deep into our evaluation codebase to lift inference throughput on evals. No two days are the same. Things move fast, and your ability to focus and prioritize is what lets you unblock the team day-to-day while designing the high-quality tooling and infrastructure that speeds us up long-term. jobs.description: adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. adjoe Ads is our programmatic in-app advertising platform that seamlessly connects advertisers and publishers through direct integration of our Android and iOS SDKs. Every ad decision happens in under 200ms across 10 million daily users, powered by real-time bidding algorithms and user quality prediction models that match the right ad to the right user at the right moment. Engine Behind 120M Processed Auctions Daily The Ad Network team builds and operates the backend services that power adjoe Ads' programmatic advertising engine. The core challenge is straightforward to state and hard to solve: for every incoming ad request from a mobile SDK, decide within milliseconds whether it's a good fit for any active campaign — and at what price to bid. To solve this, the team has built a Real-Time Bidding platform of 20+ Go microservices that orchestrate ad auctions at 1,500 bid requests per second , integrate with external demand partners via OpenRTB , and connect to ML models making 50 billion predictions daily across 600+ features to optimize bid pricing. The stack runs on Kubernetes , with Kafka handling event streaming, DynamoDB and Elasticache powering low-latency data access, and Prometheus and Grafana providing observability across the entire system. Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For: Golang Backend Foundation: You have a Computer Science degree (or related field) and hands-on experience writing Golang. You will use this foundation to contribute directly to our production backend services from day one at adjoe, rather than writing isolated or throwaway code. Proven Project Portfolio: We look for engineers with tangible projects to show, not just coursework. You will leverage the architectural lessons from your past builds—what worked, why you built it, and what you would change—to design and scale our live systems. jobs.title: Senior Embedded Android Engineer- Hardware
jobs.description: Team description SumUp's Hardware Development team builds the physical products millions of small businesses rely on every day, and this role sits right at the start of a new chapter: moving our in-house hardware onto the Android platform for the first time. This isn't a typical Android device, it's a highly customised, security-first product built from scratch, which means the person joining will help define how the operating system, drivers, and secure processor come together rather than inheriting someone else's setup. The team works closely with hardware, software, and QA engineers across the bring-up process, so this role offers a rare chance to shape a product's foundations while working alongside experienced embedded and secure processor leads. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Revenue Operations, DashOS EMEA
jobs.description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. About the Team DashOS is DoorDash's merchant technology platform. It brings together the products restaurants and local businesses use to run their own business, sell on their own channels and keep their guests coming back, including online ordering, websites and apps, and loyalty. DashOS connects these tools with the demand and growth learnings of the DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo marketplaces, so merchants can grow both on our marketplaces and on their own channels. In EMEA, we are building DashOS market by market. The team is small and works like a startup within the larger DoorDash. When joining DashOS, you will help shape a new business from an early stage: what we offer merchants to fuel their growth, how we take it to market and how we support merchants once they are live. Our Strategy & Operations team builds the DashOS business end to end in EMEA: what we focus on, how we measure success, and the playbooks that make growth repeatable. We work in small cross-functional pods that find improvement opportunities, launch and iterate, together with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Legal, Marketing, our merchant and consumer teams. jobs.title: Head of Fleet Operations - DACH
jobs.description: Warum roadsurfer? TEAMSPIRIT & TEAM-EVENTS: Flache Hierarchien, viel Spaß, ein starker Teamspirit und regelmäßige Events wie gemeinsame Sport-Sessions oder Pizza- & Bier-Abende. PERSÖNLICHE ENTWICKLUNG: Wir unterstützen dich mit einem individuellen Growth Plan und unserer Inhouse Academy. CAMPER-BUDGET: Ein jährliches Camper-Budget, damit du den #happyroadsurfing-Lifestyle selbst erleben kannst. Halte 4.000+ Camper auf der Straße Als Head of Fleet Operations DACH sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Camper startklar sind, wenn unsere Gäste losfahren wollen. Du führst unsere 2 Senior Fleet Technicians, 5 Regional Fleet Manager und damit indirekt die Fleet Manager, Techniker:innen und Schadensexpert:innen an über 40 Stationen in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz. Du berichtest direkt an unseren Business Director DACH und bist Teil des DACH-Leadership-Teams. Was dich erwartet: ein schnell wachsendes Unternehmen, ein junges, motiviertes Team und viel, das noch aufgebaut werden will. Nicht jeder Prozess existiert schon – viele davon gestaltest du selbst. Wenn du für deine Arbeit fertige Strukturen brauchst, ist das wahrscheinlich nicht das Richtige für dich. Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest Fahrzeugverfügbarkeit, Reparaturdauer, Kosten und Qualität im DACH-Markt. Du verantwortest das Budget für Wartung, Reparatur und Fahrzeugtransfers. Du baust unser Netz aus internen und externen Werkstätten und Servicepartnern auf und steuerst es. jobs.description: About Black Forest Labs We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We're creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we're just getting started. Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity. Why this role FLUX models ship as open weights, which gives anyone full access to the model. Our safety efforts focus on suppressing harmful behaviors and mitigating the risk of misuse, so safety has to be built into the models themselves, not bolted on afterwards. As a Member of Technical Staff on our safety research team, you'll research and ship methods that make FLUX models safe by design: from what goes into the training data to how the models are mid- and post-trained, across images, video and the text that conditions them. This is a role with real ownership: you won't just do research on model safety, you'll shape it. The methods you build ship in FLUX models with over 75 million downloads on Hugging Face and in production at some of the largest platforms in the world. Analysis is your starting point, not your deliverable: you are measured on whether conversion, speed to lead and productivity actually move in each market. jobs.description: As a Campaign Coordinator Intern (m/w/d), you will own the end-to-end coordination of marketing campaigns across global markets, moving them from brief to launch while keeping creative, performance, CRM, e-commerce, product and local market teams aligned. You will act as the connecting point between everyone involved, tracking dependencies, chasing inputs, and making sure each stakeholder knows what is due, when, and from whom. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to learn how large-scale campaigns are built and shipped, with a clear path to grow into a campaign or project management position as you develop. PERGOLUX designs and sells Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from pergolas to garden furniture, directly to consumers. We are a company that has grown consistently across Europe and beyond, with around 300 employees, 9-figure revenue, and operations across 8 markets. What You'll Do - Coordinate campaigns end to end across creative, performance, CRM, e-commerce, product and local market teams, managing request intake, the production calendar, briefs, timelines and approvals. - Coordinate localisation across markets by briefing translators and local teams, tracking translation status, and making sure localised assets go live correctly and on time. - Own asset repositories and DAM hygiene, including naming conventions, folder structures, versioning, metadata, and archiving of outdated assets. - Manage campaign trackers and boards (e.g. Jira), keeping status visible and flagging risks or blockers early. - Run and document campaign kick-offs, check-ins and retros, follow up on action items, support vendor and freelancer coordination, and propose process improvements that make delivery faster and more scalable. What You'll Bring - Strong organisational skills and the ability to keep multiple moving parts, deadlines and stakeholders on track at once. - Clear, structured communication in English, comfortable chasing inputs and keeping teams aligned

Implement governance and best practices for shared cloud platform ensuring safe multi-tenant operation. Deliver infrastructure as code using Terraform and Terragrunt, following Optiver standards and workflows. Build and maintain CI/CD and automated testing for changes minimizing risk in always-on markets. Implement and enhance observability using CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, and similar tools. jobs.description: PsiQuantum’s mission is to build the first useful quantum computers—machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.   Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.   Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry—including partners like GlobalFoundries—we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don’t feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.   In 2024, PsiQuantum announced government-funded projects to support the build-out of our first utility-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia, and Chicago, Illinois. En tant que Captain, tu n es pas juste un(e) chef(fe) d équipe : tu es le moteur de l entrepôt. Ton défi ? Manager environ 20 Shoppers (préparateur(rice)s de commandes) en direct, garantir une sécurité totale et transformer chaque shift en succès collectif avec +100 Shoppers sur le terrain. Si tu aimes l action et que tu sais fédérer une équipe dans la bonne humeur, ce rôle est pour toi. Tes missions Manager et coacher ton équipe : Tu supervises une vingtaine de Shoppers au quotidien, en veillant à leur motivation, leur sécurité et au respect des bonnes pratiques. Piloter la performance : Tu garantis que chaque commande est prête, complète et à l heure, en suivant de près nos indicateurs de qualité. Coordonner les flux du FC : Tu travailles main dans la main avec les autres Captains pour fluidifier les opérations et ajuster les ressources en temps réel. Assurer la polyvalence opérationnelle : Réception, gestion des stocks (sec, frais, surgelé) ou départ des camions... tu navigues entre les zones selon les besoins du planning. Gérer l humain et le terrain : Tu es le point de contact privilégié pour ton équipe, capable de recadrer avec pédagogie comme de féliciter les réussites. Organisation du temps de travail : 35 heures travaillées réparties sur 4 jours par semaine. 3 jours de repos chaque semaine. Travail le week-end, dimanche inclus, à raison de 3 semaines par mois. Des shifts tournants selon les besoins de l activité. À propos de toi Tu as entre 1 et 5 ans d expérience dans un environnement dynamique (logistique, retail, restauration ou ligne de production) avec une première gestion d équipe réussie. Tu maîtrises le français (l anglais est un plus) et tu es parfaitement à l aise avec les outils digitaux de pilotage. Tu es véhiculé(e) pour rejoindre facilement l entrepôt de Fretin. Tu n as pas peur de mettre la main à la pâte. Tu aime

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments. We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure - from powered land, to compute, to software . As we scale our platform and expand our engineering organisation, we are looking for leaders who can build strong teams, uphold high standards, and deliver reliably at pace. Job Summary: You’ll act as a trusted advisor to managers and employees, providing practical guidance and support across employee relations, performance management, manager coaching and the wider employee lifecycle for our team in France . Combining hands-on HR expertise with a solutions-focused approach, you’ll help managers navigate complex people matters confidently, ensure consistent and compliant People practices in line with French employment law across our Paris office and global teams, and drive continuous improvement through data, technology and automation as Radiant continues to scale. Managing employee relations under French law and the applicable convention collective, providing expert support and recommending appropriate actions to address queries or problems. Proactively reviewing data to spot employee relations trends and suggest solutions, coaching Managers to tackle issues early on. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Platform
jobs.description: Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company s products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact.   As a Senior Software Engineer on the Connectors Platform Team, you’ll play a key role in building products that help our customers ingest, transform, and enrich their data with AI, making it simple to integrate into Algolia. The Team & Platform The Connectors Platform Team builds and scales the services that bring our customers’ data into Algolia, reliably, securely, and at scale. Our work touches: E-commerce: powering real-time integrations with Shopify, Commercetools, BigCommerce Data Connectivity: connecting to sources like JSON, BigQuery, Supabase, MySQL, and beyond Data Transformations:  allow customers to transform their data as it flows into Algolia AI Enrichment Pipelines: enhancing data to improve search relevance We run on Go, Kubernetes, and Google Cloud, with an engineering culture built around reliability, performance, and simplicity. What You ll Do Design, build, and scale distributed data ingestion services serving thousands of global businesses Drive improvements to system reliability, scalability and throughput Champion engineering excellence in testing, observability, and performance Mentor teammates and help evolve the engineering culture as we grow You might be a fit if you Bring proven experience building and operating high-traffic production systems in Go Have strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, and Google Cloud Love the challenge of designing resilient systems

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager - France
jobs.description: Build something monumental for Healthcare! At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care. We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you! About the Role You care about making complex systems actually work, not just in theory, but in practice - across teams, stakeholders, and real-world constraints. In previous roles, you were likely the person who brought clarity to messy situations: aligning engineers, partners, and product teams to get things shipped. At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across French and European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. You'll be based in our France office, working alongside the local team, in close collaboration with our central Integrations team in Stockholm. A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners. You move fast, but not carelessly. You know how to break down complex problems, prioritize what matters, and keep momentum across multiple workstreams. You're comfortable going deep technically when needed, understanding APIs, data flows, and system constraints, while still keeping the bigger product picture in mind. jobs.title: Founding sales lead
jobs.description: Who are we? The sea is the physical layer of the economy: our energy, data and trade move across it and under it. It is also Europe's most exposed flank. Cheap underwater drones, divers and mines now threaten ports, naval bases, subsea cables and offshore energy sites, and most of what is funded today stops at detection: it tells you a drone has entered the harbour, not how to stop it before it reaches the hull or the cable. Pelagon is creating the category of maritime interdiction : detection and action together. We design, deploy and operate protection zones around critical maritime infrastructure: a persistent sensing network running our own acoustic-first AI detects and classifies threats, and an underwater interceptor acts on them. We sell to navies and coast guards , and to the civilian operators of ports, subsea cables and offshore energy. Pelagon was founded by Aymeric de Pontbriand (serial deeptech entrepreneur, founded and exited Scortex) and Gauthier Bouxin (French Navy officer, then McKinsey). A team is already in place around them: a lead embedded systems engineer, a lead hardware engineer and an a chief of staff. We are backed by Hexa , the pioneer startup studio in Europe behind Front, Aircall and Spendesk. ⚡ What is at stake in the coming months Confirm the technology at sea with navies and operators. Deploy and sign our first paid pilots. Sign our first contracts. By joining us, you'll play a key role in turning that early traction into multi-year protection contracts, and in building the sales team that follows. 🎯 Your mission Own every deal from first meeting to signed contract, with navies, port authorities and operators of cables and offshore energy. Sell interdiction, not detection alone: make the threat and the gap between alarm and response concrete for each buyer, then turn pilots into multi-year protection contracts. jobs.description: Help make the world more hospitable The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences. You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building. If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here. About the role Let s get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this: You would own Mews relationships with the press, turning company news, product launches and leadership insight into credible coverage across hospitality, travel, technology and business media. This is a new role, the first dedicated media relations seat at Mews, so the contacts you build and the way you work will set the standard for how we deal with the press. Hospitality technology offers good stories and unusual data to pitch, and leaders here respond to press requests within about a day. You would join the Communications team within Marketing and work closely with the communications lead, the colleagues who shape our stories, and leadership, product marketing and regional marketing. Day to day you would pitch journalists directly, host press briefings, handle inbound enquiries and prepare leaders to speak well in front of the press. The role is remote first in Europe, ideally near London, Berlin or Paris where many of the journalists we work with are based, with about 10% travel to meet press and attend events such as Unfold. jobs.title: DFT Engineer
jobs.description: Meet Arago and the Aragonians Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles. The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance. Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders. Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work. What you’ll do As DFT Engineer, you will define and own the Design-for-Test strategy of our next-generation SoC from the ground up. This is not a role where you inherit an existing flow, scripts, or team — you build it. You will work closely with RTL design, physical implementation, and our test partners to make our chips manufacturable, testable, and ready for volume production. Required Skills and Experience 10+ years in DFT, with at least one full SoC tape-out owned end-to-end — not just one slice of a large team effort. Strong hands-on experience with one major DFT suite: Siemens Tessent, Synopsys TestMAX / DFTMAX / TetraMAX, or Cadence Modus. Scan insertion and test compression (EDT / DFTMAX / Modus-type). MBIST and memory repair integration. JTAG / IEEE 1149.1, IEEE 1687 (IJTAG), IEEE 1500 wrappers. ATPG pattern generation (stuck-at, transition, path delay), coverage analysis and improvement. jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern
jobs.description: Meet Arago and the Aragonians Arago is an AI and computer hardware company whose mission is to drive the course of history forward. We do so by accelerating breakthroughs at the intersection of AI and semiconductors. Founded in 2024 by AI researchers and physicists with deep expertise in photonics, electronics, software, mathematics, and machine learning, Arago brings together a lean team of engineers and scientists from the world’s top companies and research labs. Composed of nine nationalities and operating from hubs in France, North America, and Israel, we believe in great science and fast achievements. Our work is guided by these core principles: Do great things: we deliver work we’re proud to sign our name to. High velocity: speed matters. We move quickly, one step at a time. One unit: we’re all in this together, with relationships grounded in trust, respect, and camaraderie. Arago is backed by executives from Apple, Arm, Nvidia, Microsoft, and Hugging Face, as well as prominent US and European deeptech venture firms and exited founders. What you’ll do As a System Software Engineer Intern, you will join the team building the foundational software stack for our next-generation high-performance computing hardware. Working at the intersection of high-level Python AI frameworks and custom hardware, you will take on a versatile role that may include performance optimization, compiler backend development, hardware simulation, or low-level driver implementation.
